data.name: Makkiyah
data.gender_notes: Makkiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Makkah', this name means 'resident of Makkah' or 'pilgrim'. In Islamic tradition, making the Hajj pilgrimage to Makkah is a requirement for every able-bodied Muslim once in their lifetime. This name embodies the spiritual journey and commitment to faith that is central to Islam. The name Makkiyah carries the meaning “Pilgrim, Resident of Makkah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Makkiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody pilgrim, resident of makkah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual journey and commitment to faith in Islam.
data.etymology: Makkiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pilgrim, Resident of Makkah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Makkiyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
